meta.note: stages are cached in Saved/p16_f0_scratch; state_before/state_after are read by this invocation

BP_Door_Base_Dungeon.row: cue on BP_Door_Base (bIncludeSubclasses, so BP_Door_Base_Dungeon and any later child use it)
BP_Door_Base_Dungeon.reason: All 4 doors are wood: leaf SM_Dungeon_door with MI_Prop_Wood_Weathered backing cubes; none is stone, so SFX_LB_Door_Stone_Open_* has no consumer in L_Monastery (keep the recordings for later). Denied fires on Door_ChapelMain (needs State.Item.ChapelKey); the other three have no required tags. NoiseLoudness 0.6.

BP_DialLever_Crypt.reason: Crypt counterweight levers (prompt 'Move counterweight', 3 notches each, iron arm). The subsystem plays DialNotch on OnDialChanged and suppresses the Interact sound when the actor has a dial, so Interact stays empty. Denied ("It won't move", bLocked) gets the dull generic use sound. NoiseLoudness 0.5.

BP_PuzzleCandle.reason: 4 chapel puzzle candles (prompt 'Light candle', single use, no required tags, NoiseLoudness 0.1). The match/flame whoosh plays at the candle.

BP_SequencePuzzle.reason: Controller actors with only a ULBSequencePuzzleComponent (no mesh, no interactable). Their sounds come from the puzzle events (SmallBellStrike / SmallBellFail / SmallBellSolved in DA_Audio), not from a cue row. SEE FINDING F-1: both placed puzzles (Puzzle_Bells and Puzzle_Candles) will play those small-bell sounds.

BP_Inspectable_Note.reason: 6 notes (Gatehouse, Nave, Sacristy, Cloister, Ossuary, Chains); prompt 'Read', bInspectOnInteract, no tags, NoiseLoudness 0. Paper rustle when the inspect view opens.

BP_RitualMechanism_ChapelBells.reason: Altar_Ritual1: a bell wheel (SM_LB_Prop_BellWheel_A) on a stone pedestal at the altar, requires State.Chapel.CandlesSolved, grants State.Ritual.1 and State.Warden.Stage.2; NoiseLoudness 1.0. Stone grinding while the altar mechanism turns; the stage-2 bell follows 2 s after the tag (plan 5.3). A row holds one sound set, so no layered winch (the plan's 'plus winch if chain-driven' is not expressible in one row).

BP_RitualMechanism_CryptWinch.reason: Winch_Ritual2: capstan drum SM_LB_Crypt_CapstanDrum_80x50 on a crypt block; chain-driven. Needs State.Item.Crank plus the three dial positions; grants State.Ritual.2 and Stage.4; NoiseLoudness 1.0. Ratchet and chain.

BP_RitualMechanism_TowerCapstan.reason: Mech_Ritual3: the tower capstan (the same capstan drum mesh, wood and iron), requires State.Tower.BellsSolved, grants State.Ritual.3; NoiseLoudness 1.0. Same winch recordings, pitched a little lower so it does not sound like the crypt winch.

BP_TagInteractable_ChapelKey.reason: Key_Chapel (iron key in the well house, prompt 'Take key', grants State.Item.ChapelKey, NoiseLoudness 0.2). Positional at the key.

BP_TagInteractable_CryptCrank.reason: DEVIATES from the brief (crank -> winch): this actor is the crank PICKUP (Crank_Winch, prompt 'Take crank', grants State.Item.Crank), not the mechanism. Picking up a loose iron crank is a metal handling clink, pitched lower than the key. The winch ratchet belongs to BP_RitualMechanism_CryptWinch, which consumes the crank. If the owner prefers a ratchet here, change Interact to SFX_LB_Winch_01..03.

BP_SmallBell_Cloister.reason: The 4 cloister bells are struck through Puzzle_Bells: ULBAudioSubsystem plays SmallBellStrike at the bell whose GrantedStateTags holds the accepted step, pitched by SmallBellPitch, and SmallBellFail at the wrong bell. A cue row on the bell would double every strike.

BP_TagInteractable_GreatBell.reason: Decision: silent. The bell (prompt 'Ring the bell') grants State.Event.Finale; plan 5.3 turns that tag into bell stage 5 x 5 strikes at BellLocation with FirstDelay 0, so the audible result of the press is already the great bell, and a second sound from the same actor would smear its attack. Phase 17 (ending) may add a rope/clapper layer.

proposed_zones.name: Chapel
proposed_zones.note: Vaulted nave with a roof (moon slits and one rain opening at x 6500): the rain is a roof patter; some wind through the openings.

proposed_zones.name: Crypt
proposed_zones.note: Below ground: almost no rain, a draught only. Top raised from -45 to -20 so it overlaps the chapel box (-40) instead of leaving a 5 cm gap on the stair; the crypt wins by priority 2 > 1.

proposed_zones.name: Cloister
proposed_zones.note: Covered walk around an open garth; roof partly collapsed. Contains the garth box, which is overridden by Garth (priority 2).

proposed_zones.name: Garth
proposed_zones.note: The open garden inside the cloister: outdoors in every respect (no room tone, no reverb, full interior wind = outdoor wind). An AudioVolume with bApplyReverb false and priority 2 cancels the cloister reverb here.

proposed_zones.name: Passage
proposed_zones.note: The shortcut passage is a 600 cm wide lane between two 800 cm walls (PSA_Wall_PS at y 1660 to 1700, PSA_Wall_PN at y 2300 to 2340, x 6040 to 9460) with NO roof (nothing overhead, nothing above in the upward traces): the rain falls in, so RoofRain is 0 and the walls only shelter the wind and add slapback reverb. SZN_Passage is much wider (y 900 to 2600) than the lane, so the audio box is the lane: y 1660 to 2340, top 900 (walls are 800). Consider exterior volume 0.7 / 6000 Hz in P16-4 because the lane is open above.

proposed_zones.name: TowerStair
proposed_zones.note: Tower base and spiral stair (Door_Tower x 12020; landings 1 to 10; top flight reaches the belfry floor at z 2500). Box is the storm shaft (-40 to 2650).

proposed_zones.name: Belfry
proposed_zones.note: Open arches under a roof. The storm zone starts at z 2650 but the belfry FLOOR is z 2500 (TWA_BelfryFloor top), so a player standing there (capsule centre 2588) would still be in the stair box; the audio box starts at 2400 and has priority 4 > 3, so it takes over on the top flight.

enclosure_notes: Well house (KD_Well_W/E/S walls plus pillars KD_Well_N1/N2, x 1275 to 1725, y -2225 to -1775, walls 250 cm high, north side open between the pillars; the chapel key lies inside): at head height the upward trace is open / open and the actors overhead are none. Nothing roofs it, so it is open to the sky: **no audio zone** (outdoors default).

Gatehouse: the gate is `KG_GateArch` (x 0 to 300, y -600 to 600, 800 cm high), an arched opening through a wall, with the gatehouse lantern, crates and warm light just inside at x 300 to 470 (`Light_Gatehouse_Warm`); there is no separate gatehouse building. Upward traces: under the arch hit at z 100, beside it hit at z 775, at the lantern open; actors overhead at the lantern: none. A 300 cm deep archway is shorter than the 1 s reverb fade and the 4 Hz zone check can resolve: **no audio zone**; the approach, the arch and the courtyard stay outdoors.

Roofs are art meshes with NoCollision, so an upward trace cannot see them; the overhead lists above are bounds lookups. Roofed (something overhead): chapel nave ['Ch_Roof_N2', 'Ch_Roof_S2'], sacristy ['Sa_Ceiling'], cloister walk ['CLA_Vault_SW', 'CLA_Roof_S_2'] and ['CLA_Vault_NW', 'CLA_Roof_N_0'], tower stair ['TWA_Cobweb_05', 'TWA_Landing_09'], belfry ['Bell', 'TWA_Headstock', 'TWA_Roof']; crypt vault ['CA_Vault_SC_1']. NOT roofed (nothing overhead): courtyard, garth, the shortcut passage lane, well house.

findings: F-1 (decision needed, C++): `ULBAudioSubsystem::NotifyStepAccepted/Failed/Solved` play the SmallBell sounds for ANY `ULBSequencePuzzleComponent`. L_Monastery has two: `Puzzle_Bells` (the cloister bells, steps State.Tower.Bell.3,1,4,2) and `Puzzle_Candles` (the chapel candles, State.Chapel.Candle.3,1,4,2). As written, lighting a chapel candle in order strikes a small bell at the candle (pitch 1.0, no SmallBellPitch entry), a wrong candle plays the dissonant SmallBellFail and the solved chapel puzzle plays SmallBellSolved. Options: (a) gate the strike by `SmallBellPitch.Contains(Step)` and fail/solved by 'all steps are in SmallBellPitch'; (b) a per-puzzle settings entry; (c) accept it for the candles. The candle's own `Candle_Light` cue still plays from its interactable row.

F-2: the belfry floor is z 2500 (`TWA_BelfryFloor` top), but `SZN_Belfry` starts at z 2650, so a standing player there (capsule centre 2588) is still inside the tower-shaft box. The proposed audio belfry box starts at z 2400 with priority 4 > 3 (tower stair), overlap z 2400 to 2650.
F-3: `SZN_Chapel` bottom is z -40 and `SZN_Crypt` top is z -45: a 5 cm gap on the crypt stair would fall back to outdoors. The proposed crypt box tops at z -20 (priority 2 > 1).

F-3b: the shortcut passage is NOT roofed and NOT as wide as SZN_Passage: it is a 600 cm lane between walls PSA_Wall_PS (y 1660 to 1700) and PSA_Wall_PN (y 2300 to 2340), x 6040 to 9460, 800 cm walls, nothing overhead. SZN_Passage (y 900 to 2600, exposure 0.3) spans the walls and the open ground south of them. The audio box is the lane; RoofRain 0. Worth a look by the lead: exposure 0.3 for an open-top lane may be low (P14 value, not touched here).
F-4: the garth sits inside the cloister box; the proposed `Garth` zone (priority 2, outdoor values, AudioVolume without reverb) cancels the cloister room tone and reverb there.
F-5: all 4 doors are wood (leaf `SM_Dungeon_door`, `MI_Prop_Wood_Weathered` backing); no stone door exists. `SFX_LB_Door_Stone_Open_*` has no consumer in this map.
F-6: the crank (`Crank_Winch`, prompt 'Take crank') is a pickup, not a mechanism; the proposal uses Key_Pickup, not Winch (deviation from the brief, reason in the table).

F-7: floor method verdict: 81.0 % of the 168 floor hits (77.5 % of all 178 resolved hits, 73.8 % of the 122 hand-picked ones without Warden-marker points) are on greybox or collision actors (hidden shells and /Engine/BasicShapes cubes), so by the plan's 80 % rule the method is **A: BodyInstance.PhysMaterialOverride on the placed floor actors, from an area-and-mesh table**. It is borderline: the visible kit slabs (courtyard, approach, chapel) are real art meshes with MI materials, but they already carry only Stone, and every non-Stone floor (Wood landings, flights and belfry floor; garth Grass; crypt Water) lies on a hidden shell or has no collision of its own, except the two courtyard garden beds (`Garden_Earth_*`, art meshes with collision, Earth). Caveat: `trace_world` returns only a distance, so actors are found by bounds (an approximation) and the real physical-material result of the footstep trace cannot be read over MCP; the check needs the `LastBell.Audio` footstep test or a play test.

F-8: MCP cannot import a WAV or create SoundClass, SoundMix, SoundAttenuation, SoundConcurrency, ReverbEffect or PhysicalMaterial assets with any listed tool; see section 8 for the S1 order of attempts. AudioVolume and AmbientSound actors can be spawned with `add_to_scene_from_class` (precedent: PostProcessVolume, 200 cm unit brush).

F-9: audio state now: AudioMaxChannels 64 present; no AudioVolume, AmbientSound, ALBAudioZone or ALBAmbientEmitter actors; no sound assets under /Game/LastBell; `/Game/LastBell/Audio` exists: False, `DA_Audio` exists: False (config already points at it).

F-10: BellLocation ((12420.1, 2000.0, 2750.0)) is the centre of the bell mesh; the bell hangs inside `TWA_BellFrame` and the belfry floor is 2500, so the bell is about 250 cm above the floor and inside the belfry audio box.
